statements.impact_statement: The Debian/Perl issue is documented for 32-bit builds. The validated runtime image is linux/amd64 and the FastAPI service does not invoke Perl. Re-review is mandatory at VEX expiry or when Debian publishes a stable fix.

The issue requires compiling an extreme Perl regular expression. The shadow scoring service executes Python/FastAPI only and has no subprocess or Perl execution path. Re-review is mandatory at VEX expiry or when Debian publishes a stable fix.

The issue concerns Perl Archive::Tar extraction of attacker-controlled links. The shadow scoring service does not invoke Perl or Archive::Tar and does not extract user-supplied archives. Re-review is mandatory at VEX expiry or when Debian publishes a stable fix.

boundary: This is a time-limited exploitability review for scanner findings with no stable Debian fix. It is not a blanket CVE ignore list. Any new CRITICAL finding, any fixed CRITICAL finding, VEX expiry, package mismatch or missing rationale fails the build.
